title: Java OOP Fundamentals
intro: Java OOP (fresher level) introduces object-oriented programming. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with classes and objects (the starting point), then the four pillars — encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction — in the order a fresher learns them. Constructors and this/super follow at the mechanics tier, then the interfaces-vs-abstract-classes question (the #1 OOP comparison). It closes with the comparisons topic.
